reported_outcomes: Bengaluru/ San Jose, July 27 — Tredence, the world's leading data & AI services company, today announced the launch of its Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) practice, committing to build a dedicated pool of 200 FDEs over the next 12-18 months. Through this practice, the company intends to build the most domain-native engineering capability in the market, helping clients move faster from problem to impact.

Enterprise AI often struggles at the last mile, where data, systems, and business decisions must come together to create measurable value. Tredence's Forward Deployed Engineers combine speed, powered by deep AI, data, and engineering expertise, with depth, built through years of domain experience, to turn AI into business outcomes faster.

use_case: OpenAI in First International ChatGPT for Healthcare Deployment
workflow: To solve workflow fragmentation and build the operational infrastructure for a fully AI-powered hospital, Sheba Medical Center has announced a collaboration with OpenAI . Driven by the ARC (Accelerate, Redesign, Collaborate) innovation arm , the agreement marks OpenAI’s first international deployment of ChatGPT for Healthcare across a complete hospital network.
